KIND:       Input.ChoiceSet
SCHEMA:     card (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

FIELD:      choices.data <Data.Query>

DESCRIPTION:
    Allows dynamic fetching of choices from the bot to be displayed as
    suggestions in the dropdown when the user types in the input field.

    Data.Query: The data populated in the event payload for fetching dynamic
    choices, sent to the card-author to help identify the dataset from which
    choices might be fetched to be displayed in the dropdown. It might contain
    auxillary data to limit the maximum number of choices that can be sent and
    to support pagination.

    YAML: `type: Data.Query`

    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

FIELDS:
  type	<string>
    Must be `Data.Query`

  count	<number>
    The maximum number of choices that should be returned by the query. It can
    be ignored if the card-author wants to send a different number.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  dataset	<string> -required-
    The dataset to be queried to get the choices.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6

  skip	<number>
    The number of choices to be skipped in the list of choices returned by the
    query. It can be ignored if the card-author does not want pagination.
    since Adaptive Cards v1.6
